content.title: Wendy's giving away free Frostys, free fries on April 7
content.text: FOODWendy'sAdd TopicYou can get a free Frosty, fries at Wendy's on April 7. Here's how. Gabe HauariUSA TODAYApril 7, 2026, 11:05 a.m. ETHear this story0:21/0:45There was a dunk during the NCAA Men's Basketball Championship Game on Monday night, April 6, which means Wendy's is giving away some freebies on Tuesday, April 7.Wendy's customers can score a free small order of fries paired with a free small chocolate or vanilla Frosty on April 7. The offer is available in-restaurant only at participating Wendy's locations in the U.S.There is no purchase necessary to redeem the offer, according to Wendy's.See offerings: Free food deals to feast on the first day of springWendy's free Frosty, free fry deal is due to NCAA championship game dunkThe national championship game Monday night featured the Michigan Wolverines facing off against the Connecticut Huskies.
